draft_en.subject: A second PoE switch line for your Facherrichter, own label possible
draft_en.body:
Hello,

Saga Telecom supplies PoE and L2+ switches to security and network distributors in Europe - under our label or the distributor's own. You already carry a dedicated network and transmission line for installers, so I will keep this to numbers.

At distributor level: STC-2224GP (24 x GE PoE+ + 2 x GE + 2 x SFP, 300 W, unmanaged) USD 86; 8-port PoE+ units from USD 28; STC-424XGGPM-280W (24 x GE PoE+ 280 W + 4 x 10G SFP+, Marvell L2+) USD 170, all EXW Shenzhen, snapshot 2026-10-27, valid 15 days, CE/RoHS/REACH, 12-month warranty. Units can carry the i-Alarmsysteme logo and your article numbers from the first order.

Is a second PoE source of interest for your 2027 line card, or is the current one exclusive?

Simon
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
